name: manual_1a1cd4
claim: Treat validation invocations as potentially state-changing: inspect command behavior and repository status after every check, because malformed help or wrapper arguments can create files or directories in the worktree.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-20: an incorrect --help invocation created an untracked --help directory; status inspection caught and removed the artifact before the held-local commit was amended.
